name: TimIntellects Trade Pricing Engine for WooCommerce
author: Ramkrishna Giri

sections.description:
TimIntellects Trade Pricing Engine for WooCommerce helps businesses manage wholesale and trade pricing within WooCommerce. It provides role-based pricing features, payment gateway restrictions, and flexible pricing rules while maintaining compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

The plugin is suitable for wholesale stores, distributors, manufacturers, and businesses operating both B2B and B2C pricing models.

Free Features

  • Create dedicated Wholesale Buyer and Distributor user roles.
  • Configure role-based payment gateways for wholesale customers.
  • Apply global percentage discounts to wholesale customer roles.
  • Prevent wholesale customers from combining trade discounts with retail coupons.
  • Store pricing configuration using an optimized data structure.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Pro Features

  • Tiered quantity pricing for individual products.
  • Fixed price, fixed discount, and percentage discount pricing rules.
  • Product-specific pricing tables.
  • Automatic tax exemption support for eligible wholesale customers.
  • Additional pricing and wholesale management features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Wholesale Buyer and Distributor roles will be created automatically.
  4. Configure pricing and payment settings from Trade Pricing in the WordPress admin area.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I create wholesale user roles?

Yes. The plugin automatically creates Wholesale Buyer and Distributor roles during activation.

Can I restrict payment gateways for wholesale customers?

Yes. Payment gateways can be assigned based on user roles.

Does the plugin support quantity-based pricing?

Yes. Tiered quantity pricing is available in the Pro version.
